name: motion-speed-stretch
title: Axis Stretch
description: Quả bóng đi tới đi lui, càng nhanh càng giãn dài theo hướng đi và dẹt lại, tròn lại khi dừng.

moworks.author: takayu

options.stretch: scaleX = 1 + stretch × q, scaleY = 1 − stretch / 2 × q (0.7)
options.peak: px a second that counts as full speed (3200)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio axis-stretch, written here): Ball x 0 → 200 px (demo; recipe 10 → 175) in 700 ms back.inOut(1.7), back again in 700 ms after a 550 ms hold. Its scale follows its own speed: scaleX = 1 + 0.7 q, scaleY = 1 − 0.35 q, q = speed / 640 px/s on the 320 px demo canvas (≈ speed / peak speed, clamped 0–1): about 170 / 65 % mid-travel, round at rest and at the back-ease turns. Optional 4 ghosts 30 ms apart at opacity 0.025–0.1. Params: duration (0.7 s) · x (175 px) · stretch: giãn tối đa (0.7) · ghosts: số bóng mờ (4).
